facts.text: The resort sits on the white sand beaches of Playa del Carmen on Mexico's Caribbean Coast, beside the Yucatan jungle.
facts.excerpt: Hugging the gorgeous white sand beaches of Playa del Carmen on Mexico's Caribbean Coast and the Yucatan jungle, Grand Velas Riviera Maya

facts.text: Grand Velas Riviera Maya is an all-inclusive resort.
facts.excerpt: Grand Velas Riviera Maya is an all-inclusive luxury refuge

facts.text: The resort has an infinity pool.

facts.excerpt: authentic gourmet dishes at seven fantastic restaurants

facts.text: The resort has nearly a dozen restaurants.
facts.excerpt: There are nearly a dozen restaurants on the premises

facts.text: The oceanfront Grand Class ambiance offers private plunge pools, Jacuzzi tubs and terraces with sunset views.
facts.excerpt: Private plunge pools. Jacuzzi tubs. Pampering amenities. Stunning sunset views from your terrace. Nothing promises more romance than our oceanfront Grand Class ambiance.

facts.text: Family suites are around the infinity pool, close to the Kids' and Teens' Clubs and steps from the beach.
facts.excerpt: spacious suites around the infinity pool and close to the Kids' & Teens' Clubs, just steps from the white sand beach and turquoise sea.

facts.text: The family-friendly Zen Grand ambiance has suites with private terraces, jungle surroundings and views of the pool and a Koi pond.
facts.excerpt: Explore the exotic and family-friendly Zen Grand ambiance. Soak up jungle vibes from your private terrace and spacious suite with views of the sparkling pool and Koi pond.

facts.text: The address is Carretera Cancun Tulum Km. 62, Playa del Carmen, Quintana Roo, Mexico.
facts.excerpt: Carretera Cancun Tulum Km. 62, Playa del Carmen, Municipio de Solidaridad, Riviera Maya, Quintana Roo C.P. 77710, Mexico

facts.text: The exterior is light blue and turquoise, and the curved architecture mimics the waves.
facts.excerpt: the light-blue and turquoise exterior reflects the waterfront setting, while the curved architecture mimics the waves

facts.text: Rooms are in cream and brown tones with local artwork, dark-wood accents and travertine floors.
facts.excerpt: Rooms in cream and brown tones are "gorgeously appointed" with local artwork, dark-wood accents, and travertine floors.

facts.text: Frida serves Mexican cuisine and Sen Lin serves Asian cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Frida serves Mexican, Sen Lin Asian.

facts.text: Staff serve drinks at the pool and on the beach.
facts.excerpt: "Staff pamper you," whether serving drinks at the pool or on the beach.

facts.text: The resort has a world-class spa.
facts.excerpt: embark on a soothing, sensory journey at a world-class spa

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards 2017 and 2018.
